Next, I will get the net balance for the 'birch' customer.
Finally, I will get the net balance for the 'cobalt' customer.

I have successfully retrieved the net balance for all customers: acme (28768 cents), birch (55306 cents), and cobalt (39255 cents). The next step is to record a payout for each customer using the recorded payout tool. I will process them one by one.

The payout for birch was successful. I will now record the final payout for 'cobalt'.
